flags.message: Frozen band is 'baseline' (sal-v4), but the petitioner is represented by the Solicitor General on behalf of a federal immigration-detention warden; the caption names no federal marker, so the caption-class rule reads it private. The petition is an express hold request pending Montoya Palacios v. Liggins (No. 25-1223, granted 2026-06-29), so neither the baseline nor the federal band rate describes this petition well; the forecast rests on the companion case.
